body:
FORMAL SCIENCE / EVIDENCE-SEMANTICS REVIEW — BLOCK

Reviewer identity: codex-mockup-science-review.

Identity and scope

I reviewed an archive of exact commit f4a2195d5599c7ded2e7882390cca68c40ab5bbf. Its direct parent is the declared base 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5. The diff is confined to mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2, and git diff --check is clean. I ran the candidate fixture court and inspected the frozen Main, Recall Matrix, Interview, and State Board PNG/HTML plates. I also compared typed vocabulary against the candidate's exact storymodel4s source pin, 3cf704a743d251b0ca09a3238b059e41883370af. This review neither authorizes nor lands anything.

Disposition

BLOCK. S1 is repaired; the important S2 and S4 visual distinctions are mostly repaired. S3 still fails a conservation check, and S5 still contains unsupported accepted chronology and non-addressable or wrongly addressed claims. There are also two places where the UI presents invented names as exact StoryModel types.

S1 — exact observation identity: PASS

fixtures.json:6-29, 32-60, and 63-88 now define three distinct observations with distinct canonical bytes, ids, hashes, coordinate systems, and source linkage/source absence. Exact spans round-trip and the mutation court is load-bearing. PROOF-BOUNDARY.md:3-12 and 73-76 now correctly distinguish identity proof from truth, admissibility, and model-output proof. The frozen plates visibly retain the synthetic/not-model-output boundary.

S2 — full AlignState recall: PARTIAL; state separation passes, canonical naming does not

RecallMatrix.dc.html:494-523 correctly ranks the full state distribution, and the r02 probe visibly preserves Source(s05)=.30 and Distorted(s05,{Attribute})=.41 rather than presenting their .71 anchor total as faithful mass. Omission remains a source-column property; unranked and named off-source destinations remain separate. This repairs the substantive flattening defect.

However, RecallMatrix.dc.html:512-520 constructs off-source state names as External(<column label>), and the frozen matrix therefore exposes External(Inference). At the exact StoryModel pin, align/matrix.scala:13-14 defines SourceConsistentInference, not Inference; AlignState.External is the constructor at lines 26-29. A compact column may say “Inference”, but an inspector claiming the exact AlignState must render External(SourceConsistentInference), or explicitly label the shorter text as a display alias. Also qualify “every row sums to 1.00” as a property of this synthetic fixture: AlignmentRow is explicitly unbalanced for non-HSMM producers at pinned matrix.scala:110-117.

S3 — feature target, coverage, missingness, and receipt: BLOCK

The plate is internally arithmetically inconsistent. Main.dc.html:479,485,491,497,503,509,515,521,527,533 publishes sentence-local observed/eligible lexical-token counts:
13/14, 12/13, 5/5, 16/18, 6/7, 11/12, 0/13, 12/14, 5/6, 12/15.
Because s01-s10 partition the 117-token source universe, those values sum to 92 observed of 117 eligible, hence 25 missing. Main.dc.html:309-310 and FIXTURE-NOTES.md:44-55 instead publish 103/117 and 14 missing. The selected-window 21/25 number cannot reconcile a whole-track discrepancy. The registered fixture court simply reasserts the global constants; it does not test this conservation law.

The missingness vocabulary is also not typed to the provider pin. Main.dc.html:515 and FIXTURE-NOTES.md:53 say Missing(ProviderNoValue). At pin 3cf704a, features/estimate.scala:33-58 contains ProviderAbstained and AllMissing (plus the declared alternatives), but no ProviderNoValue. For zero observed samples over the aggregate extent, AllMissing is the aggregate reason; provider-level abstention may remain separately receipted. Likewise “truncate + renormalise” at Main.dc.html:309/FIXTURE-NOTES.md:49 is not an EdgePolicy at the pin: core/surface.scala:82-92 has DropPartial, KeepPartial, and Pad. The successor must name the actual edge policy and put any renormalisation in the reducer/derivation receipt rather than inventing a compound enum-like label.

Pass condition: one independently checked token ledger must make every sentence, selected window, and whole-track observed/eligible/missing count agree; the rendered missing reason and edge policy must be valid typed values (or visibly namespaced Custom values), with target grain, reducer, coverage, provider, and derivation fields addressable separately.

S4 — MemoryAddress and unknown source universe: visual semantics PASS, type/proof claim PARTIAL

The Interview plate now keeps all eight address destinations visible, places Extended episode off the target projection, preserves “Okay. Um.” as transcript-only discourse evidence, and does not manufacture source coverage. The named address-scope overlay is explicitly a view-only mass-conserving projection. That repairs the MemoryAddress conflation.

But StateBoard.dc.html:274-278, FIXTURE-NOTES.md:16-18/100-102, the fixture registry, and the candidate announcement present UniverseState.Unestablished as a type that forbids coverage. No UniverseState or Unestablished type exists anywhere at the exact StoryModel pin. This is a sound desired invariant, but not present provider vocabulary or proof. Either mark it plainly as a proposed StoryAtlas view/compiler state, or obtain the required upstream ADR/contract and then consume that exact type. Do not say “the type forbids” until a type does.

S5 — field-addressable claims and epistemic/chronology honesty: BLOCK

1. The prior chronology overclaim remains verbatim in another projection. Main.dc.html:253-257 says “announced at s02, realised at s09” and “polarity reversed”. s02 is a prior report whose embedded content is not root-world fact or a future announcement; s09 cannot be shown as its realization without identity, persistence, and temporal premises. This directly contradicts the careful recurrence-only treatment at Main.dc.html:523-528 and FIXTURE-NOTES.md:31-35.

2. Main.dc.html:249-252 draws “s03 × s04 · second crossing” and says the model orders them because s04 was already holding when s03 occurs. The source does not establish that partial-order edge. If retained, it must be a styled/receipted hypothesis with evidence and alternatives, not an accepted world-order rank.

3. “Field-level claims” are not fully addressable. Main.dc.html:613-630 supplies only a generic bundled surface claim for s01-s04 and s06-s08 despite s04 saying its ownership and non-arrival fields are separate. s05 stores two alternatives as one value, “unaccompanied | unaided”, rather than two retained claims. The s09 relation cites upstream c-s02-report, but no such claim id exists: s02 resolves only to generic c-s02-surface. The s10 prose says “something seen” is entailed and intentional withholding is hypothesized, yet neither has a claim id/receipt.

4. Several evidence spans fail exact round-trip. Against fixtures.json canonicalText:
- c-s05-alone [283,290) slices “t alone”, not “alone”.
- c-s10-return [517,552) slices “He turned the boat and went back, a”.
- c-s10-nontell [554,584) slices a leading space plus “did not say what he had seen.”
These are source-address defects, not cosmetic whitespace.

5. The same overclaim shape was not swept. Main.dc.html:475-480 labels “Two boats lie drawn up” Source explicit and says every constituent is a token, but “lie” is absent. Lines 487-492 promote He=Erran and it=the reported proposition into a Source-explicit bundled mental-state claim while admitting an alternative. Lines 529-534 call “Erran returns” explicit although the text only says he turned the boat and went back; completion of a return is stronger. Split surface observations from coreference/semantic resolution and assign each its own status and evidence.

Minimum successor acceptance

- Replace the chronology portal with “reported at s02; opposite-polarity recurrence at s09; persistence/identity unestablished”, and remove or visibly hypothesize the s03/s04 world-order edge.
- Every referenced upstream claim id exists; every alternative is separately selectable; every claim field has its own status, evidence/upstream ids, and receipt.
- Every evidence span slices the exact intended source text.
- The feature ledger conserves counts across sentence, window, and track scopes and uses actual typed missing/edge vocabulary.
- Exact inspectors use canonical AlignState/ExternalState names; any shorthand is labelled as a display alias.
- UniverseState.Unestablished is marked proposed until an approved provider type exists.

The build, hash, browser, and mutation receipts remain useful artifact evidence, but they do not establish these semantic claims. Formal candidate review is BLOCK.
